A LITTLE CLARITY

Situation → Action → Impact

Concept illustration · Not a product screenshot
01

The problem

Interview preparation is more useful when a candidate can practice speaking, review specific feedback, and return to previous sessions.

02

The implementation

The application combines resume ingestion, company-specific questions, real-time voice transcription, and a Three.js interview scene. Session history and feedback are persisted in PostgreSQL.

03

An engineering decision

The feedback workflow separates two tasks: Gemini analyzes STAR structure and delivery, while Claude supplies conversational coaching and follow-up questions. Semantic question matching uses pgvector.

04

What it demonstrates

Documented features include sentence-level feedback, weak-area tracking, Google OAuth, and session history. The case study focuses on the application architecture; detailed individual contribution attribution is still being reviewed.

05

Context & limitations

Hackathon application. No hiring-outcome improvement or model-feedback accuracy is claimed. Project implementation is documented in the linked repository.

SYSTEM AT A GLANCE
  1. Resume

  3. Dual-model feedback
  4. Session history
